caption: The drawing features a single carved object positioned upright and centrally on a plain, light beige background. The object is predominantly an ivory or bone color with smooth, slightly shiny shading, and has a tapered cylindrical shape. The top portion of the object is carved in the likeness of a human head, complete with facial features such as a prominent mustache, nose, ears, and detailed long beard that extends downward onto the shaft. The head is topped with a rounded cap. The lower portion of the object tapers gently and transitions into a slightly darker brown, pointed end, suggesting it may be made of a different material, possibly wood. The artist’s name, “robert s. clark,” is printed in small, lowercase letters near the bottom right of the image. There are no additional objects, patterns, or colors in the composition, and the background remains unembellished.
title: Cane Head or Handle
